title: ElevenLabs API key (sk_) and Stripe Live secret key: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 6 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: ak_ in place of sk_, prefix: pk_ in place of sk_ (a publishable-key stem another issuer plans, never an ElevenLabs key), and prefix: sk- in place of sk_ (the OpenAI and Anthropic stem), and 3 more. Twin of "ElevenLabs API key (sk_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of elevenlabs-api-key-curl-xi-api-key: prefix: sk- in place of sk_ (the OpenAI and Anthropic stem). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
